name: Borja Giménez Larraz - Après le § 28 - Am 80
title: REPORT on the housing crisis in the European Union with the aim of proposing solutions for decent, sustainable and affordable housing
part_text: 28b. Strongly condemns slum landlord practices across Europe, where tenants – often in vulnerable situations – are forced to live in substandard, unsafe or unsanitary housing, while being subjected to exploitative rents and precarious legal arrangements; calls on the Member States to adopt a zero-tolerance approach towards slum landlords, including by using extra-legal sanctions, such as administrative penalties, fines or rental bans and where these prove ineffective, to apply civil liability mechanisms;
